description: Alpha & Omega Semi AO3400A — N-channel MOSFET, 30 V, 5.7 A continuous in SOT-23. True logic-level Vgs(th) 0.7-1.5 V — drives directly from a 3.3 V GPIO. The universal small-signal NFET for load switches, level shifters, and gate drivers in maker projects.
name: ao3400a
watch_out_for: 5.7 A continuous is the SOT-23 package thermal limit; actual silicon can do more if you can dissipate the heat. Body diode rated at full Id. For currents above ~3 A continuous step up to a DFN/PowerPAK successor (AO3422, SiR882ADP, NTMFS-series). P-channel complement is AO3401A.
